I made a small dependency-free workspace inventory CLI: [workspace_digest.py](/workspace/workspace_digest.py), with tests in [test_workspace_digest.py](/workspace/test_workspace_digest.py) and usage notes in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).

Verified with:

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v
python3 -B workspace_digest.py . --top 5 --file-limit 20
```
